notes: Efficacy study control arm (paired with -forced-r2). Task-tool subagent, no skill mentioned. Built a genuine backend/ (Express) + frontend/ (React) split, each with its own package.json, no npm/yarn workspaces field. No ARCHITECTURE.md anywhere. This run exposed a real bug in core/lib/classify.cjs: readNode() only ever read the ROOT package.json, so express/react in the nested manifests were invisible, and the project misclassified as single-part — check-architecture.js said 'architecture doc not required' instead of correctly flagging the missing doc. Fixed the same day (findAllNodeManifests, commit eb91166) and re-verified against this exact project directory: corrected verdict is BLOCK, no architecture doc found on a genuinely multi-part project. Scored here using the corrected, post-fix verdict, not the buggy one the checker originally produced. Only `architecture` was scored; other criteria not_evaluated.
